An analysis of the Load Balancing area reveals structural contradictions in its mathematical formalisation and subtle flaws in how its objective functions handle constrained models.

Here are the findings, formatted for the P-pass protocol.

```text
FINDING_ID: CC2_R2_F001
  SEVERITY: 0.85
  FLAW_CLASS: 6
  ABSTRACTION: 0.70
  VERIFIED: TRUE
  DESCRIPTION: The formal multi-objective problem definition fundamentally contradicts the system's redundancy requirements. Redundancy targets (`_redundancy_target()`) are enforced exclusively as a local heuristic inside `_solve_greedy()`. However, the formal constraint checker `_check_feasibility()` only requires single coverage for F2 (`matrix[j].sum() >= 1`). Simultaneously, the objective function `_objective()` strictly penalizes redundant assignments via increasing monetary cost (`sum(c_m * load_m)`) without any reward term for meeting redundancy targets. Consequently, the mathematical global optimum for the formulated GAP variant will ALWAYS strip away all criticality-based redundancy to minimize cost. While the greedy heuristic masks this, substituting the intended ILP solver would cause the system to systematically violate redundancy requirements because the formal objective and constraints instruct it to do so.
  PROPOSED_FIX: Redundancy must be encoded in the formal mathematical model, not just the heuristic. Update F2 in `_check_feasibility()` to enforce `matrix[j].sum() >= target`, and adjust `_objective()` to either treat unmet redundancy as a heavy penalty cost or explicitly reward reaching redundancy targets.

FINDING_ID: CC2_R2_F002
  SEVERITY: 0.76
  FLAW_CLASS: 5
  ABSTRACTION: 0.55
  VERIFIED: TRUE
  DESCRIPTION: `LoadBalancer._objective()` and `_balanced()` compute load variance via `np.var(fractions)` across the entire active model pool (`K`). However, the Project Manager (PM) is structurally excluded from standard tasks by `_admissibility_mask()`, ensuring its load fraction is always exactly `0.0` (unless K=1). Including this mandated `0.0` in the population variance artificially inflates the variance metric even when all eligible PAR/COL models are perfectly balanced. This mathematical artifact falsely reports `is_balanced = False`, driving up the objective cost penalty `lambda_bal * variance` and potentially triggering spurious reallocations or false imbalance signals in the `DynamicManager`.
  PROPOSED_FIX: Compute variance exclusively across the set of admissible models for the current task batch. Models structurally prohibited from receiving tasks (like the PM when K > 1) must be masked out of the `fractions` array before calculating `np.var()`.

FINDING_ID: CC2_R2_F003
  SEVERITY: 0.71
  FLAW_CLASS: 6
  ABSTRACTION: 0.45
  VERIFIED: TRUE
  DESCRIPTION: In `LoadBalancer._objective()`, there is no penalty for unassigned tasks. Because load costs (`monetary`, `bottleneck`) are strictly calculated from assigned token demands (`matrix.T @ demands`), an allocation matrix that leaves tasks entirely unassigned results in lower monetary and latency costs than a fully covered matrix. While `_solve_greedy` always force-assigns to meet F2, any generalized search (e.g. metaheuristics or evolutionary algorithms using `_objective` as a fitness function) would trivially achieve a perfect 0.0 cost by intentionally violating F2 and leaving all tasks unassigned.
  PROPOSED_FIX: Add a severe penalty term to `_objective()` for `matrix[j].sum() < target` (unmet demand), or definitively document that the objective function is mathematically invalid for unconstrained search and requires F2 to be pre-enforced as a hard constraint space boundary.

FINDING_ID: CC2_R2_F004
  SEVERITY: 0.62
  FLAW_CLASS: 8
  ABSTRACTION: 0.20
  VERIFIED: TRUE
  DESCRIPTION: Dead state initialization. `LoadBalancer.__init__` iterates through models and tasks to construct `self._model_idx` and `self._task_idx` dictionaries. These dictionaries are never referenced anywhere in the class logic, wasting computation and memory on unused mapping artifacts.
  PROPOSED_FIX: Remove `self._model_idx` and `self._task_idx` from `__init__`, or implement their intended usage in `_check_feasibility` to optimize the current O(N) linear string formatting lookups.
```
